# SignalingPathwayComputation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The interpretation of intracellular signaling cascades (e.g., PI3K/Akt, MAPK) as computational pathways that process molecular inputs into cellular decisions. Provides a biochemical analog for stateful computation in TCC, where signaling dynamics can inspire novel in-network processing and memory mechanisms.
